column7: 2026-11-04: isSameOrigin(a,b) semantics drafted in test/same-origin.test.ts, not yet implemented/agreed: ignore path/query/hash/userinfo, case-insensitive proto+host, default ports equal omitted, relative and protocol-relative URLs => false (no base to resolve), nullish => false

2026-11-04: isSameOrigin decision (user): NO default-port normalization; https://example.com vs https://example.com:443 must be different origins. Reason: user doesn't want magic port normalization. Tests updated accordingly; implementation still pending.

2026-11-04: isSameOrigin decision REVERSED (user): default ports DO normalize; https://example.com == https://example.com:443, http :80 likewise. Reason: platform team says the CDN rewrites links with explicit :443, so strict port rule would break them. Supersedes the earlier 'no default-port normalization' entry. test/same-origin.test.ts still encodes the OLD rule (different origins) and was intentionally left untouched (user is pushing the branch for the joinURL fix); update tests when implementing isSameOrigin.

2026-11-04: isSameOrigin implemented in src/utils.ts per reversed decision (default ports normalize: http/ws 80, https/wss 443, ftp 21); tests in test/same-origin.test.ts updated and passing (51). Not committed.
